value.rationale: Collision pairs quantify concentration and exact occupancy frequency spectra underpin Good–Turing and diversity estimators. The universal strict sign for arbitrary unequal categorical weights and every convex separable occupancy potential is structural and nontrivial. The exact bin-frequency quadratic supplies complete sign boundaries and the natural singleton zero threshold n=2m. No artificial finite cutoff is used.
